name: Joydev Mandal
headline: Aspiring Data Scientist | Machine Learning Enthusiast
intro: I am a Data Science student at IIT Madras who enjoys working with Python, exploring data and building machine learning models. I like turning messy, real-world data into answers that people can use.
about: I am pursuing the BS in Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras and have completed the Diploma in Data Science. Along the way I have worked with Python, SQL and the core data analysis and machine learning libraries.
I am most interested in using data to solve practical problems: cleaning and exploring datasets, building models, and checking honestly how well they work.
I am looking for internship and entry-level opportunities as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer, where I can learn from a team and contribute from day one.
